purpose: Descriptively test direct loss masking and consistent ID augmentation on opened public fixtures, not architecture superiority or held-out transfer.
hypotheses: Within an ID arm, full target supervision will improve flat complete-world contact/set MAP accuracy over masked targets.
Within a target mask, six-way ID augmentation will decrease ID-renaming joint-distribution sensitivity and improve flat complete-world contact/set MAP accuracy.

design.fit_order: seed ascending as declared, then arm in declared order, structured then flat
design.sensor_policy: Noiseless evaluator sensor reads every anchor ID after every action; old observations retain relative order, missing IDs appended sorted. Both model input histories are full in every arm.
design.masked_targets: Preserve the original PR43 observed IDs for each post-action target after applying the same ID map; all other target coordinates -1, including padding. Full readings still appear in the next recurrent input.
design.repeated: Six literal repetitions of each full history.
design.augmented: All six lexicographic permutations of the sorted three anchor IDs, applied consistently to all observations and actions and mapped targets; inverse round trip required.
design.episode_order: block then case then permutation index, all ascending
pre_fit_checks: same full-history tensors and valid masks across loss-target arms of each ID arm
masked targets exactly equal mapped original visible IDs and -1 elsewhere
expected counts, action order, full ID inventory and disjoint evaluation IDs
all four structured tensors and episode grouping equal
flat initial parameter fingerprints equal within each seed across four arms
every full history renaming and inverse renaming round trips
finite tensors and valid 3-bit complete sensors

fit.structured_fit_policy: One separate structured fit per seed per arm, even though inputs match; record all costs.
fit.structured_objective: episode-level two-mode contact marginal negative log-likelihood plus 0.3 mean set cross-entropy
fit.flat_objective: mean event joint-world marginal sensor NLL, marginalizing masked and padded coordinates
fit.batch: full batch, deterministic declared episode order
fit.flat_wall_budget_note: fixed_steps controls termination; wall budget is only a recorded reference, not matched compute
fit.initialization: Each fit calls torch.manual_seed(seed); verify fresh flat initial state_dict fingerprints equal across arms. Do not select seeds or adapt training.
fit.control_tables: Fit EventMemory, literal HistoryMemory.fit_full_sensor and RoleHistoryMemory once per ID arm on its 384 full sensor histories; reuse across two target-mask arms and all seeds. Record separately the table costs, sizes, target counts and hashes. NoChange has no fit.
fit.on_nonfinite: abort entire study and preserve failure report and completed checkpoints
fit.completion_policy: A successful complete result requires every seed/arm fit and case. On any fit failure abort immediately, mark unattempted work and preserve the failure report; never skip, retry selectively, or imply all arms finished.

evaluation.sensor_policy: Full noiseless feedback after every action; preserve original ordered visible readings, append missing IDs in sorted anchor-ID order.
evaluation.permutation_policy: Six lexicographic bijections of sorted anchor IDs applied consistently, with inverse round trip required.
evaluation.replay_order: case outermost; for each case complete all seed/arm/permutation/model prediction and feedback replays before any evaluator truth read for that case
evaluation.callbacks: For each paired replay both predict callbacks finish before either receives feedback; callbacks get independent copies of identical realized records. All fitted models reset per episode; no query-time learning.
evaluation.truth_policy: Read evaluator post-action truth only after every seed, arm, permutation and model replay of the physical case finishes. Keep gold out of callbacks; this is cooperative in-process ordering, not isolation or custody.
supplied_biases: structured two-mode role symmetry, exact belief update and persistence
role-normalized memory first-action slot mapping and sensor-list-order normalization
evaluation.independence: 64 already opened deterministic cases with shared IDs, repeated views and repeated seeds; not independent worlds or an independently authored challenge.

scoring.worlds: all eight binary tuples in sorted renamed ID order
scoring.map: max represented probability; exact ties choose lexicographically smallest bit tuple in sorted renamed-ID order, then inverse-map world to physical IDs
scoring.joint_brier: sum over all 8 worlds of (probability - truth indicator)^2; missing represented world has probability zero
scoring.joint_log_loss: uncapped -log(represented true-world probability); represented zero is tagged infinite with null numeric field, never JSON NaN or Infinity
scoring.abstention: Record explicit status/reason; no probability distribution or numeric proper score. Report coverage, accuracy among answered and correct/wrong per all queries.
scoring.primary: A(seed,id_arm,target) = number of correct flat full-world MAP predictions on contact/set actions divided by 1536 total eligible views
contrasts: paired previously-correct to wrong and previously-wrong to correct on same physical case, view, and step
additional: full distribution total variation after inverse ID mapping
MAP changes and exact tie flags
structured feedback status after feedback is not prediction correctness
scoring.inference: No IID confidence intervals, no free-running trajectory claim, and no cross-architecture superiority claim.

environment.device: CPU only; reject CUDA, HIP, available MPS and XPU
environment.threads_meaning: PyTorch intra-op threads are set to one; record actual inter-op thread count separately without asserting it is one.
environment.reproducibility: Different hardware or software configurations are separate refits unless weights and forecasts match; deterministic flag does not guarantee cross-host bitwise equality.

execution.output_dir: Explicit caller-chosen path outside tracked source must not exist; its parent must exist and be writable. Create it once after protocol/environment/lineage verification; never overwrite. All run results live there.
execution.lineage: Verify SHA-256 of this exact protocol and all source_file_sha256 entries before data preparation; verify source_parent is an ancestor of execution commit and tracked tree is clean. Independently review and commit the runner after this protocol commit and before the first study fit or score; record reviewed runner commit and source SHA-256, execution commit and untracked status. No audit metadata or evaluator state passed as explicit learner features.
order: verify protocol, environment, lineage and that the output path is absent; then create the output directory
prepare all training/evaluation inputs and verify inventories before any fit
fit both learned models for all seeds and arms, recording checkpoints and costs
fit shared controls per ID arm and record costs
replay all seeds, arms, views and models per physical case before accessing that case truth
score, stream case records and build complete summaries
verify checkpoints and outputs, then write success marker
execution.fit_checkpoints: Save each seed/arm/learned-model raw state_dict via torch.save to distinct file; record byte SHA-256 and independent semantic tensor fingerprint. Validate roundtrip using torch.load(weights_only=True), shape, dtype and exact tensor equality. These are checkpoints, not only fingerprints.
outputs: run metadata: protocol hash, source/runner hashes, environment, inventories, input/target/table fingerprints, supplied biases and all cost measurements
all 40 learned model checkpoints and file SHA-256/semantic fingerprints

case JSONL: physical case index, realized full history, each seed/arm/view mapping, each action truth and every model status/reason/8-world distribution/MAP/proper scores/feedback diagnostics, after case replays
summary JSON: all seeds, denominators, paired contrasts/fixes/regressions, table coverage, timing and process-wide peak RSS
failure report plus completed checkpoint/log inventory on any abort; no primary summary or success marker for incomplete execution
execution.serialization: Uncompressed JSON and case JSONL in UTF-8, sorted keys, allow_nan=False; one case per JSONL record. Represent infinite joint losses with explicit status plus null numeric field.
execution.timing: Record wall and process CPU seconds for data preparation, each learned fit, each shared control fit, every individual predict/receive callback and replay/scoring. Report p95 callback wall latency by model, action and callback kind using the nearest-rank value at one-indexed ceil(0.95*N), without interpolation. Record process-wide peak RSS and its platform-specific units; it is a high-water mark, not per-model memory. Report raw shared control fit costs and state clearly that those costs are shared across target masks and seeds, not per-arm matches.
execution.failure: A manifest, source, environment, input, timing, callback, checkpoint, missing prediction or nonfinite invariant failure stops the study and exits nonzero. Once the output directory has been created, best-effort emit failure status/phase/error/completed and missing arm/case inventory and retain available partial records and checkpoints; invalid or unwritable output paths cannot guarantee a report. Never emit complete primary summaries on an incomplete run. Do not drop a seed/arm/case or treat abstention as a failed score.
execution.retention: Preserve complete raw per-case outputs and checkpoints in a durable research artifact and retain hashes. Do not treat expiring CI artifacts or hashes alone as model checkpoints.

limits: Results describe already-opened public factorial cases and repeated views.
Masked targets remain visible in subsequent inputs; this is not withheld sensor exposure or isolated persistence learning.
Unequal target bits, objectives, model biases and measured compute forbid matched-compute or architecture-superiority claims.
Structured supplies role symmetry, persistent mechanisms and exact belief; local table supplies persistence; role-normalized table supplies first-action slots.
Post-hoc role-history memory fitting and evaluation-prefix coverage/equivariance were examined before this protocol; no evaluator truth or neural scores were examined in that check.
No independent oracle or challenge custody, sensor/event authentication, G1 promotion, language claim or 3x utility claim.
decision: G1 HOLD / REVISE regardless of public diagnostic results; report all seeded outcomes, failures, paired regressions, costs and limitations.
